verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS billing platform that stores customer and payment data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, deletion APIs, or data-erasure workflows for Stripe Billing. The customer portal, entitlement revocation and data-migration items are about other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
